why: A late update helper is installed and busy, not missing: Home no longer offers ./stack helper install (and its Copy) for it. Update now stays in sight, disabled, with ./stack update beside it; on a phone, where the command line is hidden, the hint names ./stack update.

On a phone #terminal now opens the Terminal tab, as on a desktop (the tab with Who answers' Open, Customize, the key bar and the terminal); up to 0.47 a phone had no Terminal tab and #terminal showed Chat, whose controls were this state's.

control: link:Terminal Claude Code, full screen. An external keyboard helps; closing it keeps your session.
why: More now opens the Terminal as a tab of the portal (with the key bar); its entry for the terminal alone in its own window is named 'Terminal, full screen' and says it has no key bar.

While 'Keep it on your local git server' is ticked (its default with the git server on), keeping the project starts its git repository, so this box shows ticked and cannot be unticked; the Keep box says '(this starts a git repository)'. Unticking Keep makes it a choice again, as before.
Renamed, not removed: Settings › Claude Code's switch for the Code page's Auto mode is now 'Auto mode on the Code page', so it isn't taken for the Terminal's own switch, 'Auto mode in the terminal'.

Gone with the offer under Projects: a git repository or a project folder made in the workspace (by an agent in the Terminal, a clone) is now a project by itself, with no click, and the Projects tab says so ('Added from the workspace: NAME — kept on your local git server') with Remove from Code, which is remembered. Only a repository with a remote of its own (Keep it on your local git server) or a folder without git (Start git here) has a button on its line.

Gone with the offer under Projects (see 'Add as project'): nothing is offered, so there is nothing to put off. A folder you took out of Code with Remove from Code is remembered and not added again; the 'Not now' folders of the first version are read as removed.
